title: chrysochlamys dependens var. goudotii
intro: Chrysochlamys dependens var. goudotii, commonly known as the "Puy Puy" or "Tepesuhe" plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Clusiaceae. It is a shrub native to the Andean region of South America, traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is said to have health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, fever reduction, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Chrysochlamys dependens var. goudotii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
